Title: Private preview: New telemetry for SAP Application (NetWeaver) in Azure portal

Body.Content:
SAP on Azure customers can now collect and view additional SAP Application (NetWeaver) telemetry in Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (AMS). You can view

  • Top application error logs (Short Dumps) grouped by error, program, and user
  • Response time (ST03) breakdowns by workload task type (DIALOG, RFC, UPDATE, BACKGROUND, SPOOL, HTTP etc…)
  • % CPU utilization (User + System), % memory utilization, paging, private modes, # of active user logons / sessions and other SDF/SMON data

This feature is currently available in private preview.  It is available in following regions: US East, US East 2, US West 2, North Europe and West Europe. AMS is free product (does not have license fee). Customers are responsible for consumption charges. 

To sign up for private preview, visit sign up form.

Learn more about exisitng SAP Application (NetWeaver) capabilities in AMS, visit AMS providers.

Learn more about Azure Monitor for SAP Solutions (AMS).
